breaking_news.headline: Breweries adapt as tastes in beer change

breaking_news.headline: Pro-Trump Influencer Benny Johnson is being sued for defamation by ICE protesters
breaking_news.summary: The lawsuit says the prominent conservative podcaster falsely claimed the protesters were assaulting ICE officers during demonstrations at an ICE facility in Illinois last year.

breaking_news.headline: Hawaii's iconic 550-year-old Hōlei Sea Arch collapses

breaking_news.summary: The defeat raises pressure on Sánchez to call a snap election, after a series of scandals affecting his party and allies.

breaking_news.headline: 'I was not going to let others die' - pilot of Flydubai flight describes cockpit attack by co-pilot

breaking_news.summary: As of Thursday night, Pike remained critically ill and is being treated at a hospital in Nashville, Tennessee.
